verdict.rationale: The RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell is a workstation GPU. It does not collect or ingest user data for model training, so an opt-out from training-data use is a category error for this kind of product. The docs' mention of running AI 'locally and securely' describes where compute happens, not a training-data opt-out control, and no evidence shows the product itself ships such a control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
